mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 37 degrees and overcast at Fireman's Park. We have a Waning Gibbous moon tonight, and the ISS passes overhead, though you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City news today focuses on upcoming elections and taxes. Candidate packets for the 2027 Aldermanic seats are available at the City Clerk office, and property tax bills will be mailed out no later than December 15.

Today, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness or the ART House 360 Thursday night events. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and a 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding local public safety, on November 2, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor is z. Culver's of Verona is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by later today to grab a scoop.
